description: The inference broker's declared API families (decision 0015 as amended, amendment 1 points 1 and 3). Each family is passed through untranslated to its one upstream origin. Its routes are the exact method and path pairs admitted; the auth shape is the header that carries the credential, inbound (the attempt token) and outbound (the provider key); usage names the extractor that reads the provider's usage counts. Every route set is provisional: it is pinned from observed traffic at the plan leaf that first runs the family. No upstream, provider or model is declared here: the Owner sets them in components.inference_broker of config.yml, and the model allowlists ship empty (no wildcard; model names are verified, never assumed).

families.consumer: Claude Code's ACP adapter (ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY): the Anthropic Messages API family
Codex's ACP adapter in API-key mode (OPENAI_BASE_URL through CODEX_CONFIG.openai_base_url, OPENAI_API_KEY): the OpenAI Responses API family
A native direct-LLM agent's LLM settings (model, base_url, api_key), or a local model server as the degenerate upstream (decision 0015 section 2.4): the OpenAI Chat Completions family
